The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed a '''[[Treasure ship]]''' to collect and transport the revenues of a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]] enlisted the aid of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to raid the treasure ship, but was betrayed by his own [[Fandar's right-hand man|right-hand man]]. Fandar and the Alliance operatives managed to escape the ambush.<ref name="Pirate" />
